t: This is the mausoleum of Dr Nathaniel Rogers in Abney Park Cemetery, in Hackney. Rogers was a physician who qualified at Edinburgh in 1832. He started out in Malton, Yorkshire, then moved to London, and in semi-retirement spent his winters at Exeter. He is best remembered as a donor of stained glass windows, given to Anglican churches and nonconformist chapels alike. He also edited medical books, wrote poems and letters to newspapers, chaired Baptist meetings, and lectured at Mechanics' Institutes. He lived from 1808 to 1884.
